Name: (FS) Briana - HD and Tall Farmer
Author: Shennru
Description:
[size=5][b]Briana[/b] — Fashion Sense farmer pack[/size]

A custom adult farmer for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]: long wavy blonde hair, amber eyes, a red plaid flannel shirt with rolled sleeves, blue denim overalls, and brown lace-up work boots. A straw-hat variant adds her wide brim hat with a red band.

The zip has three folders. Drop all three into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.

[list]
[*][b][FS] Briana HD[/b] (v3.0.0) — high-resolution farmer with her own action animations. Needs [b]Briana HD Helper[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Briana HD Helper[/b] (v2.0.0) — SMAPI companion that plays those animations, smooths her walk, places tools and carried items, and supplies menu portraits.[/*]
[*][b][FS] Briana[/b] (v3.0.0) — 64 px tall (2x vanilla height) vanilla-scale version of the same look, if you prefer a closer-to-vanilla farmer.[/*]
[/list]This pack is [b]SFW[/b] and fully clothed.

[size=4][b]What's new in the HD pack (v3)[/b][/size]

Action animations drawn for each job instead of reusing the standing pose:

[list]
[*]Mining (pickaxe), chopping (axe), hoeing, watering[/*]
[*]Fishing (cast + waiting/reeling)[/*]
[*]Sword / scythe swings and slingshot aim[/*]
[*]Eating, carrying an item overhead, sitting, riding[/*]
[*]Sleeping in bed and passing out[/*]
[/list]Each action has several key poses plus in-between frames. The helper times them from the game's own action timing (eased wind-up, quick strike, settle) rather than the vanilla 4-frame cadence. Walking uses an 8-frame cycle driven by how far she has actually moved, and she settles back into her standing pose when she stops.

Tools drawn in her hands (pickaxe, axe, hoe, watering can, sword, slingshot, rod) replace the game's tool sprite while the action plays. The fishing line and bobber are still drawn by the game.

In the Hand Mirror, pick the outfit preset [b]Briana HD[/b] or [b]Briana HD Straw Hat[/b].

[size=4][b]Helper options[/b][/size]

Created on first launch in [font=Courier New]Briana HD Helper/config.json[/font]:

[list]
[*][b]UseActionAnimations[/b] (true) — action animations and the smooth walk. Set false for the older v2 behaviour.[/*]
[*][b]WalkCycleLength[/b] (112) — pixels walked per two steps; lower = quicker steps.[/*]
[*][b]HideVanillaToolWhenDrawn[/b] (true) — hide the game's tool sprite while her drawn tool shows.[/*]
[*][b]ToolOffsetY / ToolOffsetX / CarryOffsetY / EatOffsetY / FitMenuPortrait[/b] — placement tweaks (same as v2).[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Known limits[/b][/size]

[b]HD pack[/b]
[list]
[*]Action poses are the same for every tool upgrade level (the drawn tool does not change colour).[/*]
[*]The straw-hat version uses the bare-head poses during actions; walking and standing keep the hat.[/*]
[*]Milking, shearing, and gold panning keep her standing pose.[/*]
[/list][b]Tall pack ([FS] Briana)[/b]
[list]
[*]Held items and tool swings stay at vanilla height, so they can appear around her chest.[/*]
[*]Some small menus may clip the hat.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]AI-assisted disclosure[/b][/size]

The character's look and colour palette were developed from AI-generated (Stable Diffusion / Forge) Stardew-style reference renders, then turned into in-game sprites. The tall pack's body geometry starts from the vanilla farmer base, stretched and recolored. Please treat this as an [b]AI-assisted[/b] visual mod.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]ConcernedApe[/b] — Stardew Valley[/*]
[*][b]PeacefulEnd[/b] — Fashion Sense[/*]
[*][b]Pathoschild[/b] — SMAPI[/*]
[*]Author: [b]Shennru[/b][/*]
[/list]Free to use and share. Do not reupload as a paid file. Compatible mods such as Fashion Sense itself are [b]not[/b] included in this zip — install them separately from their own pages.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

Required:

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] (Fashion Sense 7.5.0 targets 1.6.14+)[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b] — from Briana HD Helper [font=Courier New]MinimumApiVersion[/font]. Install from [url=https://smapi.io]smapi.io[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Nexus[/url].[/*]
[*][b]Fashion Sense 7.5.0+[/b] — required by all three folders ([font=Courier New]ContentPackFor[/font] on both [FS] packs; required [font=Courier New]Dependencies[/font] entry on the Helper). [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense on Nexus[/url].[/*]
[/list]Not required:

[list]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b] is [i]not[/i] listed in any of these three manifests and is not needed to use this pack. (Fashion Sense itself may use Content Patcher; this pack does not.)[/*]
[/list]Note: [FS] Briana HD's description says it needs Briana HD Helper, but that Helper is [b]not[/b] declared in the HD pack's [font=Courier New]Dependencies[/font] array (left empty). SMAPI will not auto-warn if the Helper is missing. Install both folders together. Originals were not edited to add that dependency.

[size=4][b]Install steps[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b], then [b]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b], then [b]Fashion Sense 7.5.0+[/b].[/*]
[*]Download this file and unzip it. You should see three folders at the zip root: [font=Courier New][FS] Briana HD[/font], [font=Courier New]Briana HD Helper[/font], and [font=Courier New][FS] Briana[/font]. Do not leave them nested inside an extra wrapper folder.[/*]
[*]Copy all three folders into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]In game, open the Fashion Sense [b]Hand Mirror[/b] and choose a preset:
[list]
[*]HD: [b]Briana HD[/b] or [b]Briana HD Straw Hat[/b][/*]
[*]Tall pack: the matching [b]Briana[/b] presets in that pack[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]If you only want one look, you can omit the other pack — but if you use [b][FS] Briana HD[/b], you must also keep [b]Briana HD Helper[/b].
